name: Unkind Blow* (Ex)
body:
Prerequisites: Improved Unarmed Strike, Stunning Fist or the stunning blow trick

Benefit(s): When the ninja makes a sneak attack with a stunning attack from the Stunning Fist feat or stunning blow trick, she may sacrifice some of her sneak attack dice to increase the save DC of the sneak attack. The increase of the stunning attack DC is based on how many sneak attack dice the ninja sacrifices as follows:

1 die = +1 to DC
2 dice = +2 to DC
4 dice = +3 to DC
8 dice = +4 to DC
